name: Bamboo-tube rice
summary: Rice grilled in a bamboo tube and eaten with sesame salt that is fragrant and nutty.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV, 25 September 2019. Thái Nguyên provincial portal, 1 April 2026. VnExpress handbook, updated 4 February 2025.
taste: The sesame salt is fragrant and nutty beside the tube.
howToEat: Split the tube. Eat it with muối vừng. Have it beside crisp-fried stream fish.
where: Pac Ngoi, at the house, and at the 2019 weekend market.
seoDescription: Rice grilled in a bamboo tube and eaten with sesame salt that is fragrant and nutty.
